versions.subject: Added Ursnif proxy detections
versions.detection:
selection:
  c-uri: '*/*.php?l=*.cab'
  sc-status: 200
condition: selection
b64encoding:
  c-uri:
    - "*_2f*"
    - "*_2b*"
urlpatterns:
  c-uri|all:
    - "*.avi"
    - "*/images/*"
condition: b64encoding and urlpatterns
